objective: To describe the layout and data source of the Delivery Note (Surat Jalan) PDF of each Delivery (cycle) in Daily Monitoring Order Detail.
To describe the on-the-fly generation, the Base64 API for downstream systems and the use as PAS GR attachment.
Traceability: Delivery -> Daily Monitoring -> Delivery Note PDF -> Base64 API -> PAS GR Attachment (key = No Cycle Order).

operation.text: Get Parameters
The report is generated on demand (on-the-fly) and is never pre-generated or generated in batch (DN-R03). It is called with the parameters in General Description "Report Generation Keys" from:

items: Daily Monitoring > Order Detail > Cycle n > Files - [Surat Jalan ELIPS] button: View (PDF preview).
Daily Monitoring > Order Detail > Cycle n > Files - [PDF] button: Download.
Delivery Note API (downstream system / PAS) - GET /api/delivery-note/{deliveryId} (endpoint TBD).
One Delivery = one cycle; deliveryId = No Cycle Order of the cycle (OQ-01).

operation.text: Create Report
2.1 Check service and request
If the Delivery Note service is not available - Return HTTP 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Log item No.1 in Logging Message Table.
If no or invalid authentication token - Return HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED (method TBD). Log item No.2 in Logging Message Table.
If deliveryId is empty - Return HTTP 400 MISSING_PARAMETER. Log item No.3 in Logging Message Table.
If deliveryId does not match the No Cycle Order format ^\d{6}C\d[A-Z]{2,5}\d{3}$ - Return HTTP 400 INVALID_PARAMETER. Log item No.4 in Logging Message Table.
If the same deliveryId is already being generated for the same request source - ignore the repeated click (DN-R07). Log item No.12 in Logging Message Table.
2.2 Retrieve delivery data
Retrieve the cycle whose No Cycle Order = deliveryId, with its Daily Order, driver master and SA data (physical tables TBD). Always read the latest committed data; nothing is cached.
If no record - Return HTTP 404 NOT_FOUND. Log item No.5 in Logging Message Table. If more than one cycle matches - Return HTTP 409 AMBIGUOUS_DELIVERY (DN-R09). Log item No.6 in Logging Message Table.

If the user may not view the delivery (same visibility as Daily Monitoring: IELP Admin / Planner all; Supplier own trucking company; Driver own truck) - Return HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN without Base64 (DN-R05). Log item No.7 in Logging Message Table. 403 vs 404 for enumeration protection: TBD (OQ-04).
2.3 Check mandatory data (DN-R01)
If any field is missing - Return HTTP 422 INCOMPLETE_DATA with missingFields[]; no PDF is created. Log item No.8 in Logging Message Table.
Optional fields (No. Telp, SA Number, CTR NO, KETERANGAN) are printed as "-" when empty. Final mandatory list: TBD (OQ-02).
Generate PDF Report File
Build one A4 portrait page for the cycle using the template in Figure 1 of Report Layout.
Printed date = system date-time at generation (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS); printed by = "System".
Calculate the data hash of the document data without printed date (DN-R04): the same delivery data gives the same hash for View, Download and API.
If generation fails - Return HTTP 500 GENERATION_FAILED. Log item No.10 in Logging Message Table. If it exceeds the SLA (TBD) - Return HTTP 504 TIMEOUT. Log item No.9 in Logging Message Table.

Validate output (DN-R06): Base64 valid, decoded file starts with %PDF- and ends with %%EOF. Otherwise Return HTTP 500 INVALID_BASE64 / CORRUPTED_PDF and do not send the file. Log item No.11 in Logging Message Table.
Return HTTP 200: deliveryId, orderNo, cycle, fileName, contentType = application/pdf, size, dataHash, generatedAt, base64. Log item No.13 in Logging Message Table.
[Surat Jalan ELIPS] shows the PDF in a preview; [PDF] saves the file with the Report File Name. Both read only; no delivery data is changed.
PAS GR Attachment
Call the Delivery Note API (step 1-3). If the result is not HTTP 200 with a valid PDF, cancel; no attachment is sent to the GR.
Idempotency key = Delivery ID (DN-R08). If an attachment with the same data hash exists, do not send a new file. Log item No.15 in Logging Message Table.
Send the PDF to PAS GR (interface contract TBD). Accepted: save / replace the attachment record, revision + 1. Log item No.16 in Logging Message Table.
Not accepted: keep the existing attachment unchanged (status Failed if none), allow retry. Log item No.14 in Logging Message Table.
REMARK >> Logging messages depend on cause (see Logging Message). SLA, maximum file size and PAS contract: TBD.
Rules, TBD and Open Questions

rows: Mandatory per cycle: No Order, Nama, No Polisi, Start Cycle, Lokasi Asal, Lokasi Tujuan.
PDF shows only the items of Item Description; empty optional value printed as "-".
On-the-fly generation per click / API call; no stored or batch PDF.
Same data -> same data hash (printed date excluded): View = Download = API.
Access = Daily Monitoring visibility; other delivery -> 403, no Base64.
Valid Base64, %PDF- header and %%EOF trailer before sending.
Repeated / simultaneous request for the same delivery is refused while in progress.
PAS attach idempotent per Delivery ID; changed data replaces file (Rev + 1).
Delivery ID must resolve to exactly one cycle, else 409 and no document.
Source of No. Telp, SA Number, KETERANGAN; logo and stamp images.
File name convention (mock SJ_<No Cycle Order>.pdf).
PAS GR interface contract (endpoint, GR key, retry, replace policy).
Confirm Delivery = one cycle, ID = No Cycle Order (order date vs cycle date prefix).
Are SA Number, No. Telp, CTR NO mandatory?
From which cycle status may the Surat Jalan be generated / attached to GR?
Data changed after GR attach: replace, new version or block?
PAS push vs pull; which key links to GR (GR No., PO No., Delivery ID)?
printed by = System or user? When is COPY watermark printed?
Which roles may view/download (Driver, Supplier Viewer, LP Admin, Planner, IELP Admin)?
Audit log of each generation needed?
